name: Claude Design (Figma-style interactive design tool at /design)
ui_location: https://claude.ai/design (sidebar link a[aria-label="Design"], href /design). Iframe-based SPA, separate quota, own composer/model/canvas.
recipe: Navigate https://claude.ai/design (or click a[aria-label="Design"]).
Optional project-type tabs: Prototype | Slide deck | From template | Other. Default = Prototype.
Type project name into input[placeholder="Project name"].
Choose fidelity: button 'Wireframe' or 'High fidelity' (plain <button>, text-addressed).
Click [data-testid="create-project-button"] (disabled until project name non-empty; becomes enabled).
Project workspace opens at https://claude.ai/design/p/<uuid> (title = project name).

Select cheap model: click [data-testid="model-selector-button"] -> click xpath=//button[normalize-space(text())="Sonnet 4.6"] (options: Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.6, Sonnet 4.5, Opus 4.6/4.7, Claude Opus 3 - use Sonnet/Haiku, never Opus).
Type design request into textarea[data-testid="chat-composer-input"] (placeholder 'Describe what you want to create...').
Submit: browser:press Enter on the composer (the [data-testid="chat-send-button"] click is refused by the CLI sensitive-content guard; Enter works).
Wait for generation: 'Stop' button -> back to 'Send (Enter)' (~24s for a simple card).
Rendered design is an HTML file inside iframe[data-testid="html-viewer-iframe"]; URL gains ?file=<Name>.html.
View/standalone: click 'Present' (xpath=//button[contains(.,"Present")]) -> menu: 'In this tab' | 'Fullscreen' | 'New tab' (New tab opens standalone HTML).
completion_gate: Composer control text transitions from 'Stop' back to 'Send (Enter)'; URL acquires ?file=<Name>.html; iframe[data-testid="html-viewer-iframe"] populated.
artifact: Generated artifact is an HTML file rendered in iframe[data-testid="html-viewer-iframe"]; openable standalone via Present->New tab. Public 'Share' link is gated by the CLI sensitive-content guard (auto-publish risk) - not exercised per policy.
evidence: .runs/web-ai-explore/stream5/claude-design-landing.png, claude-design-result.png
notes: Large self-contained app ('Claude Design Research Preview by Anthropic Labs'): own composer, own model selector, own canvas with Comment(data-testid=mode-comment)/Edit(mode-edit)/Draw(mode-draw) modes, Design System, Share, Chat history(data-testid=nav-chat-history), Add screenshot, Attach codebase, Figma import, voice(data-testid=live-voice-mic-button), import(data-testid=composer-import-button). Separate quota from main chat. Strong sub-MCP candidate - wrapping it as one tool on the main server would bloat it; warrants its own callable sub-MCP (claude-design.* : create_project, generate, get_html, present).

name: Artifacts full export (download rendered artifact as file)
ui_location: Any conversation that produced an artifact -> artifact panel (right side) -> Download button.
recipe: In main chat (div[aria-label="Write your prompt to Claude"] / [data-testid="chat-input"]) request an artifact, e.g. 'Create a tiny HTML page with an h1 that says Hello. Put it in an artifact.'
Submit via browser:press Enter on the composer (model Sonnet 4.6 default - cheap).
Wait for completion: action bar shows 'Retry'/'Copy'/'Preview' and NO 'Stop' (artifact rendered ~9s).

Artifact panel auto-opens; download button = button[aria-label^="Download "] (aria-label = 'Download <ArtifactTitle>'). Inline artifact card button (text = artifact summary) toggles the panel open if closed.

Capture with the mandated CDP pattern: node dist/src/cli.js browser:artifact-click --profile claude-9224 --tab-url-contains "claude.ai/chat/<id>" --button-selector 'button[aria-label^="Download "]' --download-dir <abs-dir> --output-json
completion_gate: Message action bar contains 'Retry' & 'Copy' & 'Preview' with no 'Stop'; button[aria-label^="Download "] present in artifact panel.
artifact: Real file written to disk via browser:artifact-click. VERIFIED: hello.html (136 bytes, valid HTML, sha256 32efd76e...) downloaded. Returns path/sha256/size/suggestedFilename JSON.
evidence: .runs/web-ai-explore/stream5/artifact-dl/hello.html, claude-artifact-rendered.png
notes: Fully cracked. Download button aria-label is dynamic per artifact title -> use prefix selector button[aria-label^="Download "]. Panel also has Copy (action-bar-copy), Close (data-testid=wiggle-controls-actions-toggle), Share (data-testid=wiggle-controls-actions-share - publish, leave guarded). HTML/React/SVG/Mermaid/code/DOCX/PDF artifacts all use this same Download button pattern.
